title: Draw a picture
summary: Get paper and draw whatever you feel like.
steps: Get paper and something to draw with.
Hang it up or show someone later.
whyItFits: It is quiet, familiar, and needs very little setup.

title: Color a page
summary: Pick a coloring page and fill it in section by section.
steps: Color one section at a time.
Fill in details if you want.
whyItFits: It is calm, clear, and uses art supplies you already have.

title: Build a tower
summary: Dump out your blocks and build the tallest tower you can.
steps: Build the tallest tower you can.
See if you can add one more piece.
whyItFits: It is easy to begin and uses a familiar building toy.

title: Do a puzzle
summary: Dump the pieces, find the edges, and fill in the middle.
whyItFits: It is structured, screen-free, and easy to understand.

title: Make a reading nook
summary: Pick a book, make a comfy spot, and read for a little while.
steps: Make a comfy spot with pillows.
whyItFits: It gives a calm activity that can last as long as needed.

title: Play a simple card game
summary: Get your cards, shuffle and deal, and play one round.
whyItFits: It uses an existing collection and provides a clear task.

title: Build a cozy fort
summary: Gather blankets and pillows and make a cozy fort to crawl into.
steps: Drape a blanket over chairs or the couch.
whyItFits: It turns ordinary household items into a clear building project.

title: Make Play-Doh shapes
summary: Open your Play-Doh and make balls, snakes, cookies, or one finished shape.
whyItFits: It is hands-on, contained, and easy to start alone.

title: Ball play outside
summary: Grab a ball, go to a safe play space, and kick, throw, or bounce.
steps: Go to a safe play space.
Kick, throw, or bounce for a while.
whyItFits: It gives an energetic child a simple activity with clear boundaries.
